intent: A firm schedule constraint on turn 1; turn 3 proposes a change that conflicts by meaning, not wording.
prompt: Remember when booking travel: I cannot fly, for medical reasons.

followups.prompt: What does the acronym HTTP stand for?
Book my Paris trip on the 8am Heathrow flight next Tuesday.

grader.regex: conflict|contradict|inconsist|does ?n[o']t (match|line up|add up)|differ|at odds|earlier (you|mentioned)|previously|before you|you (said|mentioned|noted|told me|stated)|go(es)? against|violat|not (allowed|permitted)|check(ing)? (with|first)|are you sure|sure you want|before (i|we) (go|proceed|book|schedule|draft|order)

note: Pass = the last reply flags that a flight conflicts with not being able to fly. Fail = goes ahead with the request as if the constraint had not been stated. [AL1c probe: change_review / schedule; needs a >= 0.8-confidence belief, see the audit-change-review corpusNote.]
